entries.relevance_notes: Governor of Germania inferior, probably AD 101-103/104.

segments.identification_and_sources: Plin. ep. 2, 12, 2; titulis a vexillationibus exercitus Germaniae inferioris... CIL XIII 7715. 7716. 7967.
segments.offices_and_career: consul designatus a. 100, consul suffectus eodem anno, Legatus Aug. pro pr. Germaniae inferioris
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pro pr. Germaniae inferioris paullo post, fortasse ab a. 101 usque ad a. 103/104, nominatur in titulis a vexillationibus exercitus Germaniae inferioris, q(uae) s(ub) Q. Acut(io) s(unt), Herculi Saxano dedicatis XIII 7715. 7716. 7967.
segments.prosopographical_commentary: consul designatus a. 100 in senatu sententiam dicit Plin. ep. 2, 12, 2... consul igitur suffectus eodem anno.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: Legatus Aug. pro pr. Germaniae inferioris paullo post, fortasse ab a. 101 usque ad a. 103/104
governorship_factoids.date_text: paullo post [a. 100], fortasse ab a. 101 usque ad a. 103/104
notes: Attested in inscriptions of vexillations of the army of Germania inferior dedicated to Hercules Saxanus (CIL XIII 7715, 7716, 7967).
The governorship is securely attested; only its dating is uncertain: PIR says 'fortasse ab a. 101 usque ad a. 103/104'.

career_factoids.exact_text: consul designatus a. 100 in senatu sententiam dicit Plin. ep. 2, 12, 2

review.note: A 101 confirmed as governor of Germania inferior; correct scan page is page_0032 (printed page 16).
